content.text: Configure the shortcuts used by the quick menu and per-weapon menu builder. Registered shortcuts also appear in MCM's Hotkey Manager. Changes apply after leaving MCM.

content.help: Opens or closes the inventory-limited attachment menu. If the builder is open, this switches to the quick menu. If unassigned, the plugin INI default is used.
Opens or closes the per-weapon builder. If the quick menu is open, this switches to the builder. If unassigned, the plugin INI default is used. Escape closes either menu.
Unbound disables the MCM controller shortcut. Leave the held modifier Unbound for a single button.
Optional held button (for example LB + RB or LT + D-pad Up).

content.text: Open the menu builder and choose Settings for appearance, layouts, behavior, label controls, and a mirror of these shared keybindings. Per-weapon visibility, menu-source overrides, order, and labels remain in the builder.
